verdict.rationale: Gecko documents an official MCP/AI-tools integration that lets a coding agent list scans, pull vulnerability evidence (PoC, call chain, patch diff), triage findings and file tickets. Its v1 API can trigger scans, and PR checks with a fail-on-severity threshold separate PR-introduced findings so issues are gated before merge. However, the agent integration is documented for reading and triaging results, not for scanning the agent's own code before it lands, so the loop would have to be assembled from the API plus PR checks. Missing for 10: documented MCP tool to trigger a scan from the agent, local or pre-commit scanning of uncommitted agent output, a documented agent-in-the-loop scan-before-commit workflow, and hands-on corroboration of the agent integration.
